items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical (Remote Code Execution)
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for 25 extensions, with one critical vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks the critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated remote code execution in JTL Shop (Template Injection)
items.summary: Sansec found a critical template injection flaw in JTL Shop, allowing an anonymous attacker to steal database credentials and run code on the server. JTL has released patches for every supported branch.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes lets attackers write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection)
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer (CVSS 9.8), which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source, including critical Stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686) and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653) vulnerabilities. Adobe rates this bulletin Priority 2.

items.title: Stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical Stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) addressed in APSB26-49 that could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Path Traversal vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical Path Traversal vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) addressed in APSB26-49 that could lead to arbitrary file system writes.
